title: Combining tests with AND and OR in sales

steps.title: Two tests joined by AND
steps.prompt: AND means BOTH tests must be true for a row to stay.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM sales WHERE sale_date = '2025-01-27' AND id = 2;

Add WHERE sale_date = …
Join with AND id = …
Write: SELECT id FROM sales WHERE sale_date = '2025-01-27' AND id = 2;
